objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed information object such as a policy, guideline, procedural instruction, or work instruction that goes through creation, editing, release, distribution, and archiving lifecycle.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: The classification of the document (e.g. Policy, Guideline, Procedural Instruction, Work Instruction).

attributes.name: document_level
attributes.description: The hierarchical level in the document pyramid (Level 1 through 4).

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: The document type abbreviation included in the document name.

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Cross-client consecutive 4-digit number per document type.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: The title portion of the document name.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the document (e.g. Editing, Released, Out of Force, Archived).

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: The version number of the document.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the released document version is valid.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date until which the document version is valid, calculated from Valid From plus period of extended validity.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: The time period for validity checks, default 3 years.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: The time period the document is kept after invalidation before physical deletion, default 10 years.

attributes.name: original_language
attributes.description: The language in which the document was originally created.

attributes.name: client
attributes.description: The client(s) in which the document is visible in a multi-client system.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: References to other documents or master data.

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: Referenced IT applications.

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: Companies or areas of validity associated with the document.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled sub-document attached to a main document that is subject to its own versioning and is released together with the main document.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: The version number of the attachment.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the attachment.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: A supplementary document attachment that is not subject to the release cycle of the main document and can be published directly via property switches.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the additional information (e.g. Published, Deleted).

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A proposal created by an author to request changes to an existing released document without affecting its current content or version history.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the change proposal (e.g. Created, Scheduled, Completed).

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: A system-generated request created 30 days before a document's validity expires, requiring workflow-supported processing to extend validity.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the validity extension request.

objs.name: request_for_override
objs.description: A request to invalidate and archive a released document that no longer has validity.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the override request.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: A request to reactivate a previously invalidated and archived document, can only be created by the Business Admin group.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the reactivation request.

objs.name: user
objs.description: A person in the system who can hold roles such as author, co-author, reviewer, releaser, translator, or reader.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The name of the user.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A group of users used for assigning read or change authorizations and distribution lists.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The name of the user group.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: The type or purpose of the group (e.g. Reader, Author, Reviewer, Releaser, Archive, Business Admin).

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A list of user groups and persons assigned to a document who are informed about releases, either by email or for acknowledgement.

attributes.name: distribution_type
attributes.description: Type of distribution: by email or for acknowledgement.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: A predefined template associated with a document type that can be selected when creating new document objects.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The name of the template.

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: A workflow instance that supports a process such as release, validity extension, override, reactivation, or acknowledgement.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: The type of workflow (e.g. Release, Validity Extension, Override, Reactivation, Acknowledgement).

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the workflow.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: A signature provided by a workflow participant to confirm completion of a workflow step.

attributes.name: signer
attributes.description: The user who signed.

attributes.name: step
attributes.description: The workflow step for which the signature was provided (e.g. Creator, Review, Release).

attributes.name: timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time the signature was applied.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: A new document object is created in the system by attaching a new information object with selection of a document type and optional template.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: The type of document being created.

attributes.name: template_used
attributes.description: The template selected for document creation, if any.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: The content of a document is edited using the implemented editing client in the corresponding Office component.

evts.name: edit_document_properties
evts.description: The metadata and attributes of a document are maintained or modified in the properties dialog.

attributes.name: category
attributes.description: The metadata category being edited (e.g. Master Data, Control Release).

evts.name: convert_to_pdf
evts.description: After saving, the document is automatically converted to PDF format for web display.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Read or write authorizations are assigned to users or user groups on a document.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: The role for which authorization is assigned (e.g. Reader, Author, Co-Author, Reviewer, Releaser).

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: The 3-step approval process (Creator - Review - Release) is initiated by the author or a co-author.

evts.name: sign_creator_step
evts.description: The registered author signs the first step of the release workflow with an electronic signature.

evts.name: complete_review_step
evts.description: A reviewer completes the review step of the release workflow, either approving or rejecting.

attributes.name: decision
attributes.description: Approval or rejection of the review.

evts.name: complete_release_step
evts.description: A releaser completes the release step of the release workflow, either approving or rejecting.

attributes.name: decision
attributes.description: Approval or rejection of the release.

evts.name: reject_workflow
evts.description: A rejection during review or release causes the workflow to be canceled for all subsequent participants.

attributes.name: step
attributes.description: The step at which rejection occurred (Review or Release).

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: The document is approved and automatically published, becoming visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: A new editing version of a released document is created due to content changes, attribute changes, attachment changes, or change proposals.

attributes.name: trigger
attributes.description: The reason for the new version (e.g. Content Change, Attribute Change, Attachment Change, Change Proposal).

evts.name: create_attachment
evts.description: An attachment (controlled sub-document) is created and linked to a main document, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: An existing attachment is modified, triggering a new version of the associated main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: An attachment is marked for archiving and archived upon release of the next version of the main document.

evts.name: create_additional_info
evts.description: Additional information is added to a document without affecting the main document's version or release cycle.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: Additional information is deleted directly from a document without affecting the main document.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is created for an existing released document by a user with author rights.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is scheduled for implementation, creating a new version of the document.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: The author documents the completion of an assigned change proposal, which then is no longer displayed in the document.

evts.name: create_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: The system automatically creates a validity extension request 30 days before a document's validity expires.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: The validity of a document is extended, updating the Valid Until date by the default period and deleting the validity extension request.

evts.name: create_request_for_override
evts.description: A user with write access creates a request to invalidate a document, automatically starting the override workflow.

evts.name: declare_out_of_force
evts.description: A document is declared out of force: the last valid version gets status Out of Force, editing versions are deleted, and rights are revoked except for the archive group.

evts.name: physical_deletion
evts.description: After the archive period expires, the archived document is physically deleted from the system.

evts.name: create_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: A member of the Business Admin group creates a request to reactivate an invalidated document.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: An invalidated document is reactivated: a new version is created with preserved metadata, authorizations are restored, and archived attachments are reactivated.

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Users and user groups on the distribution list are informed by email notification when a new document version is released.

evts.name: distribute_for_acknowledgement
evts.description: Users and user groups on the distribution list are requested by email to actively confirm acknowledgement upon release.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: A recipient confirms acknowledgement of a document via a workflow-supported task without signature.

evts.name: send_email_notification
evts.description: The system informs users about workflow task status, pending tasks, or document events via email.

attributes.name: notification_type
attributes.description: The type of notification (e.g. Workflow Task, Validity Extension, Override, Change Proposal, Acknowledgement).

evts.name: start_translation
evts.description: Translation of a released document's content into another language is initiated.

attributes.name: target_language
attributes.description: The language into which the document is being translated.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: The translated version of a document is checked and released with workflow support, making it visible to readers in the corresponding login language.

attributes.name: target_language
attributes.description: The language of the released translation.
